progression.narrative: The performance opens on Cs5 and dwells most on B in Mansuri, Pt. 2. The line peaks at D#5 (634.3 Hz) at 0:35.8. It closes on Gs4, not the tonic (F#4 → F#4 → F#4 → Gs4 → Gs4 → Gs4).
